name: Chao hau
summary: Cháo hàu is oyster porridge on the lagoon, a nourishing bowl seasoned moderately.
origin: Lang Co, on Đầm Lập An. Báo Quốc Tế, 14 April 2026. Nhân Dân, 5 July 2024, and VietnamPlus, 9 February 2016, also name the porridge.
howToEat: Eat it as a bowl on the lagoon. The porridge is seasoned moderately.
where: Đường Nguyễn Văn, along Đầm Lập An.
seoTitle: Chao hau in Lang Co — oyster porridge
seoDescription: Cháo hàu is oyster porridge on Đầm Lập An, a nourishing bowl seasoned moderately.
